what: How the 300 cells in labels.csv were drawn from the 459 claim-book cells of the paper's three entries (3 entries x 3 books x 51 claims), and which were labelled.
sampling_judge: gemini-3-flash-preview__v1 (the v1 judge record of each entry, submissions/<entry>/judge_record_gemini-3-flash-preview.json)
sampling_rule: Stratified by the sampling judge's majority verdict; within a stratum every cell on which the five v1 passes disagreed was taken first, then a seeded random fill balanced across the nine books. Every contradicted cell was taken. Book and cell codes were assigned in seeded order and the mapping was sealed until labelling closed.
labelling_order: Rows within a book were shuffled by the sample seed and labelled as a prefix of that order, books E to I breadth-first; the prefix rule was fixed before labelling began, so no cell was chosen or skipped because of its content.

fill_draw.reason: At 250 labelled cells the blanks were concentrated on six claims; ten further unlabelled cells on those claims were drawn with this seed and labelled on 2026-10-16 before the key was opened.

rater: one human rater, labelling blind to the entry and to the judge verdicts; labels made 2026-10-11 to 2026-10-16
